name: Yiff Strip Trivia (EP1)
source:
Yiff Strip Trivia is an adult furry stripping game, where you answer increasingly complicated trivia questions, in an effort to strip a cute bunny!

The first of a series of games by Furry Outpost. Seeing as how Veronica, our lead character in this game, is a rabbit, you'll be expected to answer a series of rabbit-related trivia. If you get three questions wrong, it's game over! If you get through all six rounds, you'll be in the company of a naked and quite embarrassed rabbit.

[From [url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep1-trivia]itch.io[/url]]
